verdict.rationale: Clerky publishes developer docs for a Partner API with concrete REST endpoints (POST /v1/document_sets, GET forms, submit JSON, poll state), discoverable via llms.txt. However, the API is scoped to partners, covers only Delaware C-Corp formations, and its authentication is documented as 'coming soon', so general programmatic driving is not yet available; the separate MCP server is described as read-only. Missing for 10: launched/available authentication, general public (non-partner) access, coverage beyond C-Corp formation, write-capable agent access, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Clerky Partner API lets partners bring a Clerky-powered formation workflow into their own product. It currently supports Delaware C-Corporation formations.
Create a document set from a template. | [`POST /v1/document_sets`]
OAuth-based access is coming soon; client registration, URLs, scopes, token lifetime, and refresh behavior will be published before partner integrations launch.
